title: thymus carolinianus
intro: Thymus carolinianus, commonly known as Carolina thyme, is a species of flowering plant in the mint family, native to the southeastern United States. This herb is valued for its potential health benefits, including its antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and alleviate respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Carolina thyme include thymol, carvacrol, and borneol, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its ability to act as an antiseptic, antispasmodic, and expectorant. Additionally, the plant's leaves and flowers can be used to make teas, essential oils, and infusions that can be used to promote relaxation and reduce stress.
